title: Limited on the Review and on a Debate side
description:
Per the map ticket 'Limited' (harness-0sx.8, codex, the second agent), refined by 'Prototype: the /config modal' (harness-0sx.9, REVIEW IF LIMITED) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, the rule by Stage).

Review: when the Review's App hits its limit, one Question for the run, asked on the first Ticket that hits it: wait for the reset / review with <fallback> (only when the Review's 'if limited' row is set) / open the PR unreviewed. The answer stands for every Ticket that reaches Review until the reset, and those Tickets start no session on the limited App; after the reset Reviews go back to it. The State keeps the answer with the limit (Ticket 14). Wait: the Ticket is Limited, its Review pane is kept and gets 'continue' at the reset + 2 minutes, and later Tickets hold before Review until then. Review with the fallback: stage-review runs on the fallback row's App, model and effort (on claude in the Run directory with --add-dir <worktree>, under Ticket 11's guard). Open unreviewed: that Round's Review and Debate are skipped; the last Fix runs with Open PR yes, no fix items, and an Input 'Unreviewed: <app> was limited until <t>', and stage-fix writes in the PR that no second model reviewed it and a human review is required.

A Debate side: the Orchestrator passes an Input 'Side B: limited until <t>' (or side A) when it already knows; stage-moderate also reads the side command's limit text (codex exec exits 1 with it on stderr; claude -p exits non-zero with it on stdout) as a limit, not a failed side. TypeSafe on: no argument; every Finding, the audit's too, goes to the TypeSafe score (0.5 or more is fix), and the Verdict is marked '<app> limited'. TypeSafe off (the Input from Ticket 20; until then, no key): every Finding is skip, settled '<app> limited, no TypeSafe', listed in the PR, and Fix runs with nothing to fix. A side on the Moderator's own App that hits the limit is the Moderator's limit: it reruns that side after the reset, the Moderator pane Limited meanwhile (Ticket 14).

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world: a codex limit on Ticket A's Review raises one Question; 'open the PR unreviewed' skips Review and Debate for A and for Ticket B reaching Review before the reset, and the Fix Inputs carry Open PR yes and the Unreviewed input; 'review with claude' starts stage-review on claude with the fallback's model; 'wait' holds B before Review and resumes A's pane at the reset; after the reset Reviews start on codex again; the Moderator gets 'Side B: limited until <t>'. stage-moderate and stage-fix carry the new rules.
